name: io.github.Denpex/denpex-mcp
title: Denpex
description: Diagnose GPU and ML training failures (CUDA OOM, NCCL timeouts, Xid faults) locally or via cloud.

environmentVariables.name: DENPEX_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Denpex API key (dpx_...). Omit for offline zero-egress mode.

environmentVariables.name: DENPEX_OFFLINE_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to enforce strict zero-egress offline diagnosis.
